name: Aegis Bulwark Gaming B650-Plus WiFi
analog: ASUS TUF Gaming B650-PLUS WIFI (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Military-spec B650 board: tan-striped armour heatsinks, steel x16 slot, Wi-Fi and 2.5 GbE.
doc_notes: Memory: install one module in A2; two modules in A2 and B2; four modules in A1, A2, B1 and B2. DDR5 only.
Front panel header F_PANEL (2x5, 2.54 mm, pin 10 keyed): 1 HDD_LED+, 3 HDD_LED-, 2 PLED+, 4 PLED-, 6 PWR_SW, 8 PWR GND, 5 RESET GND, 7 RESET, 9 NC.
M.2_1 (under the M.2 shield, CPU lanes) takes a 2280 NVMe SSD: remove the shield, peel the pad film, insert the SSD at 20 degrees and fix it at the 2280 standoff.
Press DEL or F2 at power-on to enter the BIOS setup, F8 for the boot menu.
Socket V5: remove the PnP cap only after the CPU is installed; keep it for returns.
Connect the 24-pin ATX and the 8-pin CPU power (EPS) before the first boot.
Front USB: USB3_1 is the 19-pin header; HD_AUDIO is next to it at the bottom edge.
BIOS FlashBack: put the BIOS file on a FAT32 stick in the marked USB port and hold the button for 3 seconds.

name: Strata SP-V 1S Server Board
analog: Supermicro H13SSL / ASRock Rack GENOAD8X-class single-socket SP5 board (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Single-socket Arc Epoch board: 12 DDR5 RDIMM slots, 3 x PCIe 5.0 x16, OCP 3.0 NIC slot, 2 x M.2, BMC with dedicated LAN.
doc_notes: Memory: 12 channels, one RDIMM per channel. Populate P0_DIMMA1 first, then follow A, G, C, I, E, K, B, H, D, J, F, L; use 12 identical RDIMMs for full bandwidth.
Socket SP-V: open the force frame (screws 3-2-1), lift the rail frame, slide the CPU carrier in, close the rail frame, close the force frame and tighten 1-2-3 to 1.6 N·m with a T20.
Front panel header F_PANEL (2x5, 2.54 mm, pin 10 keyed): 1 HDD_LED+, 3 HDD_LED-, 2 PLED+, 4 PLED-, 6 PWR_SW, 8 PWR GND, 5 RESET GND, 7 RESET, 9 NC.
M.2_1 and M.2_2 take 2280 NVMe SSDs (a 22110 standoff position is printed too).
Press DEL at power-on for the BIOS setup, F11 for the boot menu.
BMC: the dedicated management LAN is the RJ45 above the two USB ports; the UID button lights the blue LED.
Power: connect the 24-pin ATX and every 8-pin EPS (JPWR) before the first boot.

name: Strata L46 2S Server Board
analog: Supermicro X13DEI-class dual-socket LGA4677 board (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Dual-socket Tiron Platinum board: 16 DDR5 RDIMM slots, 4 x PCIe 5.0 x16, 2 x M.2, BMC with dedicated LAN.
doc_notes: Memory: 8 channels per CPU, one RDIMM per channel. Populate P0_DIMMA1 and P1_DIMMA1 first; keep both CPUs identical; 16 RDIMMs for full bandwidth. CPU1's slots work only with CPU1 installed.
Socket L46: clip the CPU to the cooler first (processor-heatsink module), set it on the four studs and tighten the T30 nuts in the order 1-2-3-4 printed on the board.
Front panel header F_PANEL (2x5, 2.54 mm, pin 10 keyed): 1 HDD_LED+, 3 HDD_LED-, 2 PLED+, 4 PLED-, 6 PWR_SW, 8 PWR GND, 5 RESET GND, 7 RESET, 9 NC.

Press DEL at power-on for the BIOS setup, F11 for the boot menu.
BMC: the dedicated management LAN is the RJ45 above the two USB ports; the UID button lights the blue LED.
Power: connect the 24-pin ATX and every 8-pin EPS (JPWR) before the first boot.
